name: mcp-kling
description: MCP server for Kling AI — 12 tools for video generation, image generation, lip-sync, video effects, virtual try-on, and account management. Integrates directly with Claude Desktop via Model Context Protocol.
author: Boris Djordjevic / 199 Longevity

install.npx: npx -y mcp-kling@latest (add to Claude Desktop config)

security_review.notes: TypeScript MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, axios, jose for JWT. No eval(), no child_process, no shell execution. JWT auto-generated per request from HMAC-HS256. NOTE: repo .env was committed with author's real API keys — NOT copied into this plugin (only .env.example included).
